walls.note: Singel front (Commons: Zairon Fassade 1 and 3, CC BY-SA 4.0; Alf van Beem, CC0): two buttressed brick towers either side of a centre bay with two tall pointed three-light windows over two pointed portals, a small gable with louvres and a cross between the towers. Panorama 00023 shows the portal in close-up.

items.where: two slender octagonal slate spires with four gablets and corner pinnacles each, gilt cross finials; the right spire a little taller
items.how: builder: octagonal cone from 34.5 m to 53 / 56 m, four triangular brick gablets and four stone pinnacles round the base, gold cross; heights from photographs because 3DBAG cuts the spires, the pair is not exactly equal in the photos either
items.seenIn: Commons De Krijtberg Singel (Alf van Beem, CC0)

items.where: two square brick towers 4.2 m wide to 33 m: buttressed corners, string courses, a lancet window mid-height, paired louvred belfry lancets
items.how: builder: tower prisms with string courses at 8, 15, 24.5 and 33 m, corner buttress piers on the front, pointed window ring and paired dark lancets on three faces

items.where: two very tall pointed windows with three lights and a traceried head in the centre bay (10.5 to 20 m)
items.how: builder: pointed outline ring, glass, two mullions and transoms every 0.9 m; the tracery head is left plain

items.where: two deep pointed portals with stepped brick and stone mouldings, plank leaves behind black iron gates with a gilt cross above (centre bay) and two smaller doors at the tower feet
items.how: builder: three stepped arch rings, dark leaf slab, five iron bars and two rails, gold cross; the gate scrollwork is not modelled

items.where: small brick gable between the towers (25 to 36 m) with three louvre lancets, stone raking copings and a stone pinnacle with a gilt cross
items.how: builder: brick triangle, three dark lancets, two coping boxes, pinnacle and cross

items.where: cross basilica: nave under a 33.5 m ridge, aisles at 15 m, transepts with gables, polygonal apse
items.how: builder: cross prism to 25.8 m with ridged arms clipped on valley diagonals, aisle lean-to roofs, apse fan roof

walls.note: Long flanks (RCE 20369642): aisle wall with tall pointed windows and clerestory lancets above, buttressed; windows are placed on a regular pitch, the photographed bay count is not counted exactly.

items.where: lancet windows in the aisle walls and the clerestory, seven bays per side
items.how: builder: pointed windows at a regular 3.8 m pitch on both aisle and clerestory walls; buttresses are omitted on the flanks

walls.note: Transept gables are hidden by the Singel houses and presbytery; by the cross-basilica plan they carry the same window language as the front (RCE 20369642 shows the roofs only).

items.where: transept gables with a tall pointed window, two small lancets and a roundel
items.how: builder: window ring, two lancets, stone-ringed round window and rake copings, composition inferred

walls.note: Apse and choir are behind the block of houses; massing from BAG and 3DBAG roof planes only.

sources.name: Zairon, Amsterdam De Krijtberg Fassade 1 and 3
